paragraphs: Our mission is to deliver the ultimate experience to gamers by providing high-quality, high-performance gaming accessories, including headsets, controllers, keyboards, mice, flight and racing simulation hardware, microphones, and more. For over 50 years, we have been a pioneer and key innovator in audio technology, and today we are one of the most recognized brand names in gaming. Headquartered in San Diego, California, we were incorporated in the state of Nevada in 2010, and our stock is traded on the Nasdaq Global Market under the symbol TBCH.

According to retail sales tracking data from The Circana Group ("Circana"), we have been the market share leader in console gaming headsets for 16-years running with a vast portfolio of headsets designed to be multiplatform compatible with the latest Xbox, PlayStation, and Nintendo consoles, as well as for personal computers ("PCs") and mobile and tablet devices. Our PC product portfolio includes PC gaming headsets, keyboards, mice, microphones, and other PC gaming peripherals, and we expanded our brand beyond gaming headsets to include our gaming controller product line, as well as flight simulation. In 2024, we acquired Performance Designed Products ("PDP"), another leading gaming accessory brand with a robust slate of products, including gaming controllers for all major platforms and licensing deals with popular gaming and entertainment properties.

We launched our first gaming headset and the first ever console gaming headset – the X51 – in 2005 and have gone on to become the leading brand in gaming headsets, as well as a top five overall gaming accessory business in the world. We design and market a broad assortment of gaming headsets and audio accessories for Xbox, PlayStation, and Nintendo consoles, as well as for PC, mobile and tablet devices. Our 2024 acquisition of PDP, and prior acquisitions of ROCCAT (2019) and Neat Microphones (2021) expanded our reach into the global markets for PC gaming headsets, keyboards, mice, and other gaming accessories. Additionally, in 2021, we further expanded our reach beyond gaming headsets with the launch of the first Turtle Beach game controllers for Xbox/PC, as well as flight simulation accessories. In 2024, we entered the racing simulation gaming accessory market. Our gaming accessories are distributed globally, with more than 475 thousand points of distribution, including major retailers such as Amazon, Argos, Best Buy, Target, and Walmart.

Our brand offers gamers a broad assortment of gaming accessories available at price tiers ranging from entry-level ~$30 to ultra-premium $650+. These price tiers correspond to customer profiles, beginning with entry-level gamers and progressing through casual, enthusiast, core, as well as with professional streamers, content creators, and competitive esports gamers. Each successive price tier incorporates higher-level features, comfort, and finish. For example, premium headsets typically include features like larger 50mm speakers, metal headbands, memory foam, powerful amplified 3D surround sound, active noise-cancellation, and Bluetooth connectivity. Additional features include mic monitoring which allows you to hear the volume of your own voice inside your headset, gaming audio presets like bass and/or vocal boost, our exclusive Superhuman Hearing® sound setting which delivers a competitive advantage, a removable or flip-to-mute microphone, our proprietary ProSpecs glasses-friendly technology, and long-lasting rechargeable batteries.

Gaming consoles like the latest Xbox, PlayStation, and Nintendo Switch systems have evolved into full home entertainment hubs, and mobile tablet devices have become mainstream entertainment platforms with gaming on mobile and tablet devices now representing approximately 50% of the global gaming market. We continue to evolve our product portfolio to reflect how content is consumed. While each Turtle Beach headset is designed for a primary platform, such as a specific console or PC model, nearly all can be used with multiple platforms and are compatible with mobile and tablet devices through a standard 3.5mm jack or Bluetooth connectivity. Additionally, our products are often displayed in multiple in-store sections at retailers. This includes platform-specific gaming aisles for Xbox, PlayStation, Nintendo, PC, Virtual Reality (VR), and mobile and tablet products, as well as displayed on in-store kiosks that allow shoppers to experience each headset's fit, feel, and audio quality, increasing the prominence of our brand in physical retail locations, as well as online.

We operate in a nearly $200.0 billion global games and accessories market, according to Newzoo Peripheral Market Forecast. The global gaming audience now exceeds global cinema and music markets with over 3.5 billion active gamers worldwide. Gaming peripherals, such as headsets, controllers, keyboards, mice, microphones, and flight and racing simulation controls are estimated to be an $11.2 billion business globally.

The console and PC gaming accessory markets are also driven by major game launches and long-running franchises that encourage players to continually buy equipment and accessories. On Xbox, PlayStation, Nintendo Switch, and PC, flagship games like Call of Duty, Destiny, Star Wars: Battlefront, Grand Theft Auto, Battlefield, and battle royale games like Fortnite, Call of Duty Warzone, Apex Legends, and PlayerUnknown's Battlegrounds, are examples of major franchises that prominently feature online multiplayer modes that promote player-to-player communication and drive increased demand for gaming headsets, controllers, and more. Many of these established franchises launch new titles annually, leading into the holidays and beyond, and as a result can cause an additional boost to the normally strong holiday sales for gaming accessories. Additionally, some larger franchise games, for example Call of Duty and Fortnite, follow-up with multiple post-launch downloadable content or new content update packs, to keep interest and fan engagement/momentum going for months following a game's initial release. Many gamers play online where a gaming headset, which includes a microphone, is required because it allows players to communicate with each other in real-time, provides a more immersive experience, and delivers a competitive advantage.

In 2025, we were the leading gaming headset manufacturer in the U.S. and other major console markets. We have achieved these global market shares by delivering high-quality products that often include first-to-market innovations, robust features, superior sound, unmatched comfort, and top customer support – all key factors that consumers seek when shopping for a gaming headset.

The global market for console and PC gaming headsets is estimated to be approximately $2.9 billion, according to external market data and internal estimates, reflecting continued growth driven by increasing online multiplayer engagement, content creation, and improvements in technology. PlayStation and Xbox consoles remain among the most significant platforms supporting gaming headset usage, as console-focused headsets continue to integrate features such as wireless connectivity and surround sound optimized for these systems. Consistent with a historical pattern of major new console cycles of roughly seven to eight years, Microsoft and Sony launched their latest consoles, Xbox Series X|S and PlayStation 5, ahead of the 2020 holiday season, and these platforms have sustained an active installed base through 2025. In late 2024, Sony introduced the PS5 Pro system. The next Microsoft and Sony consoles are anticipated to launch within the next 2-3 years.

Nintendo's platform also plays a significant role in the growth of the console headset market. The large installed base of Nintendo Switch systems, combined with the successful launch of the Nintendo Switch 2 in June 2025, increases participation in online, chat-enabled gameplay, thereby expanding the overall addressable market for console gaming headsets.

The controllers market is estimated at approximately $3.0 billion, according to external market data and internal estimates, and shares the same retail footprint and consumer base as Turtle Beach gaming headsets, creating natural cross-sell opportunities and strong category alignment. We entered the controllers market in 2021 and have since expanded our portfolio across console and PC platforms, with key products including Stealth Ultra and Stealth Pivot premium controllers, which target the higher value controller segment. The 2024 acquisition of PDP, a leading gaming accessories company with a strong foundation in the controller category, significantly strengthened our scale and competitiveness in controllers. PDP's established expertise and product portfolio, spanning high-value and enthusiast-driven segments, expanded our offerings with products such as the Riffmaster® Wireless Guitar Controller and Victrix® Pro BFG®, Pro FS® Arcade Fight Stick, and Pro KO® Leverless Fight Stick, positioning us across both premium and value tiers and across multiple controller subcategories.

Industry activity across console platforms, continues to support category growth. Ongoing hardware refresh cycles and the large global installed base, continues to drive engagement across core gaming genres such as multiplayer, esports, fighting games, and rhythm‑based gaming. These trends, along with market forecasts projecting sustained controller demand tied to wireless adoption, haptic feedback innovations, and cross‑platform compatibility, indicate that the controllers category remains an attractive growth opportunity.

With an expanded product portfolio and enhanced innovation pipeline following the PDP acquisition, we believe we are well positioned to capture additional share in the global controllers market as consumer interest and platform ecosystems continue to evolve.

Our brands face significant competition from other consumer electronics companies and this competition could have a material adverse effect on our financial condition and results of operations.
The manufacture, supply and shipment of our products are subject to supply chain and logistics risks that could adversely impact our financial results.

Turtle Beach relies on its partnerships with influencers and esports teams to expand our market and promote our products, and our marketing and promotion partners may not perform to our expectations.

Our net sales and operating income fluctuate on a seasonal basis and decreases in sales or margins during peak seasons could have a disproportionate effect on our overall financial condition and results of operations.
Our results of operations and financial condition may be adversely affected by global business, political, operational, financial and economic conditions.
Our business could be negatively affected as a result of actions of activist stockholders.
Risks Related to our Intellectual Property and Other Legal Matters
Our competitive position will be adversely damaged if our products are found to infringe on the intellectual property rights of others.
If we are unable to obtain and maintain intellectual property rights and/or enforce those rights against third parties who are violating those rights, our business could suffer.
We are dependent upon third-party intellectual property to manufacture some of our products.
We are dependent on license agreements with third-parties for the sale of some of our products.

We depend upon the availability of capital under our revolving credit facility and term loan to finance our operations. Any additional financing that we may need may not be available on favorable terms, or at all.
The market price of our common stock may continue to fluctuate significantly.

We are subject to laws and regulations relating to data privacy, data protection, and other related matters, which are subject to change, and our failure to comply could negatively affect our business and reputation.
We have been party to stockholder litigation, and in the future could be party to additional stockholder litigation, which could harm our business, financial condition and operating results.
Loss of our key management and other personnel could impact our business.
paragraphs: Set forth below is a summary of certain material risks related to an investment in our securities, which should be considered carefully in evaluating such an investment. Our business, financial condition, operating results and cash flows can be affected by a number of factors, whether currently known or unknown, including but not limited to those described below, any one or more of which could, directly or indirectly, cause the Company's actual results of operations and financial condition to vary materially from past, or from anticipated future, results of operations and financial condition. Any of these factors, in whole or in part, could materially and adversely affect the Company's business, financial condition, results of operations, cash flows and common stock price. Additional risks and uncertainties not presently known to us or that we currently consider immaterial may also impair our business operations.

These risk factors may be important to understanding any statement in this Annual Report on Form 10-K or elsewhere. The following information should be read in conjunction with our financial statements and related notes in Part II, Item 8, "Financial Statements and Supplementary Data" and Part II, Item 7, "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations" of this Report.

Because of the following factors, as well as other factors affecting the Company's financial condition and operating results, past financial performance should not be considered to be a reliable indicator of future performance, and investors should not use historical trends to anticipate results or trends in future periods. Please also see "Statement Regarding Forward-Looking Disclosures" in the section immediately preceding Item 1 of this Report.

We are exposed to inflationary pressures affecting our costs and demand for the products we sell. In recent years, our business has been affected by global supply chain constraints and unfavorable changes in economic or political conditions in the countries and markets where we operate, resulting in heightened inflationary cost pressures. Such inflationary pressures have also been and could continue to be exacerbated by geopolitical turmoil and economic policy actions and could lead to a recessionary environment. Further, adverse changes in interest rates could lead to increases in our borrowing costs over time.

Inflationary pressures can also have a negative impact on demand for the products we sell. Reduced or delayed discretionary spending by consumers, specifically for consumer electronic goods, in response to inflationary pressures has reduced and could continue to reduce demand for our products, resulting in reduced sales. Our inability to adequately increase prices to offset increased costs associated with such inflationary pressures, or otherwise mitigate their impact, will increase our costs of doing business and could further reduce our margins and profitability. If such impacts are prolonged or substantial, they could necessitate impairment tests in the future or otherwise have a material negative effect on our results of operations.

Changes in U.S. or foreign trade policies, including the imposition of tariffs on imported goods and other trade restrictions, as well as uncertainty over such actions, may adversely impact our business and financial performance.

We are headquartered in San Diego, California, and incorporated in the state of Nevada in 2010.

We have achieved these global market shares by delivering high-quality products that often include first-to-market innovations, robust features, superior sound, unmatched comfort, and top customer support – all key factors that consumers seek when shopping for a gaming headset.

We entered the controllers market in 2021 and have since expanded our portfolio across console and PC platforms, with key products including Stealth Ultra and Stealth Pivot premium controllers, which target the higher value controller segment. The 2024 acquisition of PDP, a leading gaming accessories company with a strong foundation in the controller category, significantly strengthened our scale and competitiveness in controllers. PDP's established expertise and product portfolio, spanning high-value and enthusiast-driven segments, expanded our offerings with products such as the Riffmaster Wireless Guitar Controller and Victrix Pro BFG, Pro FS Arcade Fight Stick, and Pro KO Leverless Fight Stick, positioning us across both premium and value tiers and across multiple controller subcategories.

The market for PC gaming mice, keyboards, and microphones is estimated to be approximately $3.9 billion, according to external market data and internal estimates. PC gaming continues to be a main gaming platform in the U.S. and internationally, similarly driven by popular AAA game launches, PC-specific esports leagues, teams, and players, content creators, and influencers, and with the introduction of cross-platform play – where PC gamers can play online against other gamers playing the same game on an Xbox, PlayStation, or Nintendo Switch. While most games are available on multiple platforms, gaming on PC offers advantages including improved graphics, increased speed and precision of mouse/keyboard controls, and the ability for deeper customization. Gaming mice and keyboards are engineered to provide gamers with high-end performance and a superior gaming experience through features such as fast key and button response times, improved materials and build quality, comfortable ergonomic designs, programmable keys and buttons, and software suites to customize and control devices and settings.

PC gaming mice come in a variety of different ergonomic and symmetrical shapes and sizes, are available in both wired and wireless models, offer different optical or laser sensor options and responsiveness, and often feature integrated RGB LED lighting and software to unify the lighting with other devices for a visually consistent PC gaming appearance. Similarly, PC gaming keyboards often deliver a competitive advantage by offering options for ultra-responsive mechanical and optical key switches that feel and sound different, as well as customizable lighting.

Our PC gaming headsets, keyboards, and mice span price tiers ranging from low-to-high for entry-level to professional gamers, with each successive price tiers adding features and build quality. We seek to infuse differentiation and innovation into our PC products, including our own design for keyboard and mouse switches, innovative RGB LED lighting, and extensive ergonomic design testing and modeling.

The market for simulation accessories is estimated to be approximately $1.4 billion, according to external market data and internal estimates. Flight and racing simulation are more dominant on higher-end PCs able to deliver the most realistic visuals. However, jumps in visual quality made possible in the latest consoles and games have made flight simulation on Xbox and PlayStation more accessible. For example, in 2020 Microsoft redefined the graphics flight simulation gamers can expect while playing with the launch of the latest generation of its flight simulation games and, in subsequent years, Microsoft expanded the game to Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, and for lower-end gaming PCs, and mobile gaming via Xbox Cloud.

Long-running popular flight simulations like Flight Simulator 2024, X-Plane, and others allow pilots to learn to fly and pilot various aircraft through picture-perfect skies and scenery, with typical flight simulation accessories including yokes and pedals, combat flightsticks, and Hands-On Throttle And Stick ("H.O.T.A.S.") controllers. The flight simulation market is niche, but with a dedicated, older fanbase willing to spend more on accessories to create the ultimate flight simulation setups, with a variety of expert pilots and creators showcasing their latest content on YouTube and other mediums. We launched the original VelocityOne Flight universal control system in 2021, followed by the VelocityOne Rudder and VelocityOne Stand in 2022, the VelocityOne Flightstick in 2023, and the VelocityOne Flightdeck H.O.T.A.S controller in 2024.

Racing simulation follows a similar trajectory as flight simulation. The audience of racing simulation gamers is also dedicated, slightly older and willing to spend more on creating high-end racing simulation setups predominantly on PC, but also on consoles. There is also a variety of long-running, successful racing game franchises including Forza, Assetto Corsa, and more that allow drivers to get behind the wheel and experience the rush of racing. Typical racing simulation accessories include wheel and pedal setups, swappable steering wheels, shifters, handbrakes and more, ranging in price from lower cost entry-level gear available for a couple of hundred dollars (~$200), to ultra-premium, high-end custom-built simulation racing setups that cost thousands of dollars. Racing simulation fans also regularly create their own content to share with the racing simulation community. We introduced our first VelocityOne Race racing simulation wheel and pedals setup in 2024, as well as the follow-up add-on VelocityOne Multi-Shift shifter/handbrake in early 2025. In the latter portion of 2025, we released the VelocityOne KD3 wheel and pedals system, the F-RX formula wheel for hardcore simulation racers on Xbox and PC and the Racer wireless racing wheel.

paragraphs: 本公司之使命為透過提供高品質、高性能的遊戲配件，包括耳機、控制器、鍵盤、滑鼠、飛行與賽車模擬硬體、麥克風等，為遊戲玩家帶來最佳的體驗。在超過 50 年的歷史中，本公司一直是音訊科技的先驅與關鍵創新者，而今天本公司已成為遊戲領域最受認可的品牌之一。本公司總部設於美國加州聖地牙哥，於 2010 年在內華達州註冊成立，並在納斯達克全球市場上市，股票代碼為 TBCH。

根據零售銷售追蹤資料，由 The Circana Group（"Circana"）提供，本公司已連續 16 年為遊戲主機耳機市場的市佔率領先者，擁有廣大的耳機產品線，設計為跨平台相容，可與最新 Xbox、PlayStation 和 Nintendo 主機，以及個人電腦（"PC"）和行動與平板裝置使用。本公司 PC 產品線包括 PC 遊戲耳機、鍵盤、滑鼠、麥克風及其他 PC 遊戲周邊設備，並已將品牌拓展至遊戲耳機之外，包括遊戲控制器產品線，以及飛行模擬。於 2024 年，本公司收購 Performance Designed Products（"PDP"），另一家領先的遊戲配件品牌，擁有強大的產品組合，包括所有主要平台的遊戲控制器，以及與知名遊戲與娛樂內容的授權合作。

本公司於 2005 年發佈首款遊戲耳機，也是首款遊戲主機耳機 – X51，並成為遊戲耳機領域的領導品牌，同時也是全球前五大遊戲配件業務之一。本公司設計與行銷一系列遊戲耳機與音訊配件，適用於 Xbox、PlayStation 和 Nintendo 主機，以及 PC、行動與平板裝置。於 2024 年收購 PDP，以及先前收購 ROCCAT（2019 年）與 Neat Microphones（2021 年），擴展了本公司在 PC 遊戲耳機、鍵盤、滑鼠及其他遊戲配件的全球市場。此外，於 2021 年，本公司進一步拓展至遊戲耳機之外，發佈首款 Turtle Beach 遊戲控制器，適用於 Xbox/PC，以及飛行模擬配件。於 2024 年，本公司進入賽車模擬遊戲配件市場。本公司遊戲配件在全球發行，擁有超過 475,000 個銷售點，包括 Amazon、Argos、Best Buy、Target 和 Walmart 等主要零售商。

本公司品牌為遊戲玩家提供廣泛的遊戲配件選擇，價格區間從入門級 ~30 美元至高階 $650+。這些價格區間對應不同玩家的客羣，從入門級玩家開始，進階至休閒、熱衷、核心玩家，以及專業串流者、內容創作者與競技電競玩家。每個價格層級皆包含更高階的規格、舒適度與外觀。例如，高階耳機通常包含較大的 50mm 音響喇叭、金屬耳墊、記憶棉、強大放大 3D 環繞音效、主動降噪、藍牙連線等功能。其他功能包括麥克風監聽，讓玩家可以聽到自己聲音的音量，遊戲音效預設如低音與/或人聲增強，本公司專屬 Superhuman Hearing® 音效設定，提供競爭優勢，可拆卸或翻轉靜音麥克風，本公司專利 ProSpecs 眼鏡友好技術，以及長效可充電電池。

如最新 Xbox、PlayStation 和 Nintendo Switch 系統等遊戲主機已進化為完整的家庭娛樂中心，而行動平板裝置已成為主流娛樂平台，遊戲在行動與平板裝置上的佔比已約為全球遊戲市場的 50%。本公司持續進化產品組合，以反映內容的消費方式。雖然每款 Turtle Beach 耳機皆為特定平台設計，如特定主機或 PC 型號，但幾乎所有產品皆可與多種平台使用，並透過標準 3.5mm 耳機孔或藍牙連線與行動與平板裝置相容。此外，本公司產品常在零售商的多個專區展示。這包括針對 Xbox、PlayStation、Nintendo、PC、虛擬實境（VR）以及行動與平板裝置的平台特定遊戲專區，並在商店內的互動展示站臺展示，讓消費者體驗耳機的貼合度、手感與音質，提高本公司品牌在實體零售與線上商店的曝光度。

遊戲主機與 PC 遊戲配件市場也受到主要遊戲發行與長期系列作品的推動，這些作品鼓勵玩家持續購買設備與配件。在 Xbox、PlayStation、Nintendo Switch 和 PC 上，如 Call of Duty、Destiny、Star Wars: Battlefront、Grand Theft Auto、Battlefield 以及戰術競技遊戲如 Fortnite、Call of Duty Warzone、Apex Legends 和 PlayerUnknown's Battlegrounds 等，都是具有重要影響力的系列作品，這些遊戲強調線上多人模式，促進玩家間的對話，並提高遊戲耳機、控制器等產品的需求。許多這些系列作品每年都會發行新遊戲，並在節日季節後持續推出，因此會導致遊戲配件通常強勁的節日銷售額進一步提升。此外，一些大型系列遊戲，例如 Call of Duty 和 Fortnite，會在遊戲發行後推出多個追加下載內容或新內容更新包，以維持玩家興趣與參與度，持續延續遊戲熱潮數個月。許多玩家在線上遊戲時，需要使用包含麥克風的遊戲耳機，因為這允許玩家實時溝通，提供更沉浸的體驗，並提供競爭優勢。
於 2025 年，本公司為美國及其他主要遊戲主機市場的領導遊戲耳機製造商。本公司透過提供高品質的產品，常包含首創市場的創新、強大功能、優異音質、無與倫比的舒適度與頂級客戶服務，達成這些全球市場佔有率。這些皆為消費者在購買遊戲耳機時所尋求的關鍵因素。

全球遊戲耳機的市場規模估計約為 2.9 十億美元，根據外部市場資料與內部預估，反映持續成長，主要驅動因素為在線多人遊戲參與度增加、內容創作以及技術改進。PlayStation 和 Xbox 主機仍是支持遊戲耳機使用的主要平台之一，因為專注於主機的耳機持續整合無線連接和為這些系統優化過的環繞音效等功能。與歷史上大規模新主機週期約為七至八年的情況一致，微軟和索尼於 2020 年聖誕節前推出了他們最新的主機，Xbox Series X|S 和 PlayStation 5，這些平台自 2025 年以來持續維持活躍的裝置基礎。2024 年末，索尼推出了 PS5 Pro 系統。微軟和索尼的下一代主機預計將在未來 2 至 3 年內推出。
任天堂的平台也在遊戲耳機市場的成長中扮演重要角色。任天堂 Switch 系統的龐大裝置基礎，加上 2025 年 6 月成功推出任天堂 Switch 2，增加了線上、支援聊天功能的遊戲參與度，從而擴大了遊戲耳機的總可達市場。

控制器市場估計約為 3.0 十億美元，根據外部市場資料與內部預估，與 Turtle Beach 遊戲耳機共享相同的零售 footprint 和消費者基礎，創造自然的交叉銷售機會和強大的類別對齊。我們於 2021 年進入控制器市場，並自那之後擴展了我們的產品組合至主機和 PC 平台，關鍵產品包括 Stealth Ultra 和 Stealth Pivot 高端控制器，這些產品針對高價值控制器市場。2024 年收購了 PDP，這是一家在控制器類別中擁有強大基礎的遊戲配件公司，顯著強化了我們在控制器領域的規模和競爭力。PDP 已建立的專業知識和產品組合，涵蓋高價值和熱衷玩家驅動的市場，透過產品如 Riffmaster® 無線吉他控制器、Victrix® Pro BFG®、Pro FS® 遊戲打鬥搖桿和 Pro KO® 無桿打鬥搖桿，使我們橫跨高端和價值層級，以及多種控制器子類別。
遊戲主機平台的產業活動持續支持類別成長。持續的硬體更新週期和龐大的全球裝置基礎，持續推動核心遊戲類型如多人遊戲、電競、格鬥遊戲和節奏型遊戲的參與度。這些趨勢，加上市場預測顯示與無線採用、觸覺反饋創新和跨平台相容性相關的控制器需求持續存在，顯示控制器類別仍然是一個有吸引力的成長機會。
在收購 PDP 後，我們的產品組合擴充並創新管道增強，我們相信我們已處於有利位置，以捕捉全球控制器市場的更多份額，隨著消費者興趣和平台生態系統持續演進。

PC 遊戲滑鼠、鍵盤和麥克風的市場規模估計約為 3.9 十億美元，根據外部市場資料與內部預估。PC 遊戲繼續是美國和國際上主要的遊戲平台，同樣受到熱門 AAA 遊戲發行、PC 特定的電競聯賽、隊伍和玩家、內容創作者和影響者推動，並隨著跨平台遊戲的引入 – 允許 PC 玩家與在 Xbox、PlayStation 或 Nintendo Switch 上玩相同遊戲的其他玩家進行線上對戰。雖然大多數遊戲都可在多種平台播放，但 PC 遊戲提供了優勢，包括改進的圖形、提高的滑鼠/鍵盤控制速度和精確度，以及更深層的自訂能力。遊戲滑鼠和鍵盤透過快速的按鍵和按鈕回應時間、改進

paragraphs: 以下討論應配合我們的合併財務報表及其附註一併閱讀。本討論總結了影響我們營運結果及業務財務狀況的關鍵因素，涵蓋近三年財務年度，截至2025年12月31日為止。

我們是一家首屈一指的音訊與遊戲科技公司，具備開發、商業化及行銷創新產品的專業知識與經驗，產品應用於多種可達成的市場，並以我們的Turtle Beach品牌為主。Turtle Beach®品牌在遊戲主機耳機市場已連續16年維持市佔率領先地位，擁有廣泛的耳機產品線，設計為跨平台相容，支援最新的Xbox、PlayStation及Nintendo主機，以及個人電腦與行動裝置與平板電腦。我們的個人電腦產品線包括個人電腦遊戲耳機、鍵盤、滑鼠、麥克風及其他個人電腦遊戲周邊設備，並於2021年將品牌拓展至遊戲耳機之外，推出遊戲控制器產品線，以及飛行模擬與賽車模擬配件。2024年，我們收購了PDP，另一家領先的遊戲配件品牌，擁有強大的產品組合，包括所有主要平台的遊戲控制器，以及與知名遊戲與娛樂IP的授權合作。我們總部設於美國加州聖地牙哥，於2010年在內華達州註冊成立。
2025年，我們是美國及其他主要主機市場的領先遊戲耳機製造商。我們透過提供高品質的產品，經常包含首創市場的創新、強大的功能、優越的音質、無與倫比的舒適度及頂級的客戶服務，達成這些全球市佔率。這些都是消費者在購買遊戲耳機時所尋求的關鍵因素。

全球用於主機與電腦遊戲耳機的市場規模據外部市場資料與內部預估約為 2.9 十億美元，反映持續成長，主要驅動因素為在線多人遊戲參與度增加、內容創作以及技術改進。PlayStation 與 Xbox 主機仍為支持遊戲耳機使用最重要的平台之一，因為專注於主機的耳機持續整合如無線連接與針對這些系統優化之環繞音效等功能。與歷史上主要新主機週期約為七至八年歷史模式一致，微軟與索尼於 2020 年聖誕節前推出其最新主機 Xbox Series X|S 與 PlayStation 5，這些平台已維持活躍的裝機基礎至 2025 年。2024 年晚期，索尼推出 PS5 Pro 系統。微軟與索尼的下一代主機預計將在未來 2-3 年內發佈。
任天堂的平台在遊戲耳機市場的成長中也扮演重要角色。任天堂Switch系統的龐大安裝基礎，加上2025年6月成功推出任天堂Switch 2，增加了線上、支援聊天功能的遊戲參與度，從而擴大了遊戲主機耳機的總可達市場。

控制器市場據外部市場資料及內部估計約為 3.0 十億美元，與 Turtle Beach 遊戲耳機共享相同的零售據點與消費者基礎，創造自然的交叉銷售機會與強勁的類別協同效應。我們於 2021 年進入控制器市場，並自那之後擴展我們的產品組合至主機與 PC 平台，關鍵產品包括針對高價值控制器類別的 Stealth Ultra 與 Stealth Pivot 高端控制器。2024 年收購 PDP，一家在控制器類別有強大基礎的領導遊戲配件公司，顯著強化了我們在控制器領域的規模與競爭力。PDP 已建立的專業知識與產品組合，涵蓋高價值與熱衷者驅動的類別，透過如 Riffmaster Wireless Guitar Controller 與 Victrix Pro BFG、Pro FS Arcade Fight Stick 與 Pro KO Leverless Fight Stick 等產品，擴展了我們的產品線，使我們在高端與價值層級以及多種控制器子類別中佔有地位。
遊戲主機平台的產業活動持續支持類別成長。持續的硬體更新週期與龐大的全球安裝基礎，持續推動核心遊戲類型如多人遊戲、電競、格鬥遊戲與節奏型遊戲的參與度。這些趨勢，加上市場預測預示與無線採用、觸覺反饋創新與跨平台相容性相關的持續控制器需求，顯示控制器類別仍然是一個有吸引力的成長機會。
隨著收購PDP後產品組合的擴展與創新管道的提升，我們相信我們已具備優勢，可於全球控制器市場中捕獲更多市佔率，隨著消費者興趣與平台生態系統的持續演進。

PC 網路遊戲用滑鼠、鍵盤及麥克風市場據外部市場資料及內部預估約為 3.9 十億美元。PC 網路遊戲持續為美國及國際上主要的遊戲平台，同樣受到熱門 AAA 遊戲發行、PC 專屬電競聯賽、球隊、玩家、內容創作者及影響力人物的推動，並因跨平台遊玩的引入而更加興盛，其中 PC 玩家可與在 Xbox、PlayStation 或 Nintendo Switch 上玩相同遊戲的其他玩家進行線上對戰。雖然大多數遊戲都可在多種平台進行，但 PC 遊戲提供優勢包括更佳的圖形效果、滑鼠/鍵盤控制的更高速度與精準度，以及更深層的自訂功能。遊戲滑鼠及鍵盤透過如快速鍵與按鈕反應時間、改進的材料與建構品質、舒適的人體工學設計、可程式化鍵與按鈕，以及軟體套件以自訂與控制裝置及設定等功能，為玩家提供高階性能與優越的遊戲體驗。
PC 網路遊戲用滑鼠有各種不同的人體工學與對稱形狀與尺寸，有線與無線型號皆有，提供不同的光學或雷射感測器選項與反應速度，並常具備整合式 RGB LED 燈光與軟體以統一其他裝置的燈光，以達到視覺一致的 PC 網路遊戲外觀。同樣地，PC 網路遊戲用鍵盤透過提供超快速反應的機械與光學按鍵選項，這些按鍵的觸感與聲音不同，以及可自訂的燈光，來提供競爭優勢。
我們的 PC 網路遊戲用耳機、鍵盤與滑鼠涵蓋從低價到高價的價格層級，以符合入門級至專業玩家的需要，每個更高階的價格層級皆增加功能與建構品質。我們致力於在 PC 產品中注入差異化與創新，包括我們自行設計的鍵盤與滑鼠按鍵、創新 RGB LED 燈光，以及廣泛的人體工學設計測試與建模。

模擬配件市場據外部市場資料與內部預估約為 1.4 十億美元。飛行與賽車模擬在高階 PC 上更為盛行，這些 PC 可提供最逼真的視覺效果。然而，最新主機與遊戲中視覺品質的提升，使在 Xbox 與 PlayStation 上進行飛行模擬變得更易於接觸。例如，在 2020 年，微軟透過發行最新一代的飛行模擬遊戲重新定義了飛行模擬玩家可期待的圖形，並在隨後幾年將遊戲擴展至 Xbox Series X|S、Xbox One，以及較低階的 PC 遊戲，並透過 Xbox Cloud 進行行動遊戲。

長期流行的飛行模擬遊戲如 Flight Simulator 2024、X-Plane 等，讓飛行員透過完美的天空與景觀學習飛行與駕駛各種飛機，典型的飛行模擬配件包括操縱桿與腳踏板、戰鬥飛行桿，以及 Hands-On Throttle And Stick ("H.O.T.A.S.") 控制器。飛行模擬市場屬於小眾，但擁有忠實且年紀較大的粉絲羣，願意花更多錢購買新配件以建立最佳的飛行模擬設置，並有許多專家飛行員與創作者在 YouTube 等平台展示他們的最新內容。我們於 2021 年推出了原始的 VelocityOne Flight 通用控制系統，隨後於 2022 年推出 VelocityOne Rudder 與 VelocityOne Stand，2023 年推出 VelocityOne Flightstick，以及 2024 年推出 VelocityOne Flightdeck H.O.T.A.S 控制器。

賽車模擬的發展軌跡與飛行模擬相似。賽車模擬玩家的觀眾羣同樣忠實，年紀較大，願意花更多錢建立高階的賽車模擬設置，主要在 PC 上，但也包括主機。此外，還有許多長期成功且知名的賽車遊戲系列，包括 Forza、Assetto Corsa 等，讓駕駛員可以坐上駕駛座體驗賽車的快感。典型的賽車模擬配件包括輪與腳踏板設置、可更換的轉向盤、換檔器、手剎等，價格從數百美元 (~$200) 的入門級配件，到數千美元的高階、客製化賽車模擬設置不等。賽車模擬愛好者也會定期創作自己的內容與賽車模擬社羣分享。我們於 2024 年推出了首款 VelocityOne Race 賽車模擬轉向盤與腳踏板設置，以及隨後的追加配件 VelocityOne Multi-Shift 換檔器/手剎於 2025 年初。在 2025 年後半，我們推出了 VelocityOne KD3 轉向盤與腳踏板系統、F-RX 公式轉向盤供 Xbox 與 PC 的 hardcore 模擬賽車玩家，以及 Racer 無線賽車轉向盤。

headings: 與我們營運相關的風險
我們的業務已受到通貨膨脹壓力及潛在經濟衰退擔憂的負面影響，且情況持續存在。
我們依賴第三方遊戲平台的成功與可用性，以及成功遊戲題材的發行與可用性，以推動我們遊戲配件的銷售。
我們的品牌面臨來自其他消費電子公司的激烈競爭，這種競爭可能對我們的財務狀況及營運結果產生重大負面影響。
我們產品的製造、供應與運送受到供應鏈及物流風險的影響，這些風險可能對我們的財務結果產生負面影響。
訂單交貨時間及供應受限。若這些零組件的供應中斷，可能對我們的第三方製造夥伴生產我們產品的能力產生重大影響。
若我們的行銷努力未能有效提升我們品牌的認知度與聲譽，我們可能無法成功執行我們的遊戲配件成長策略。
Turtle Beach 依賴與影響者及電競隊伍的合作關係，以拓展我們的市場並推廣我們的產品，而我們的行銷與推廣夥伴可能無法達到我們的預期表現。
本公司淨銷售額及營運收入會因季節性因素而波動，若在旺季期間銷售額或毛利率下降，可能對本公司整體財務狀況及營運成果產生不成比例的影響。
本公司營運成果及財務狀況可能因全球商業、政治、營運、財務及經濟環境而受到不利影響。
本公司業務可能因激進股東的行動而受到負面影響。
與智慧財產權及其他法律事務相關的風險
若本公司產品被判定侵犯他人的智慧財產權，將會對本公司競爭地位造成不利影響。
若本公司無法取得並維持智慧財產權，或無法對違反智慧財產權的第三方進行執行，本公司業務可能受到影響。
本公司製造部分產品依賴第三方智慧財產權。
本公司銷售部分產品依賴與第三方簽訂的授權合約。
我們依賴於我們循環信貸融資及定期貸款所提供之資金來支應我們的營運。我們可能需要的額外融資可能無法以有利條件取得，或甚至無法取得。
我們普通股的市場價格可能持續顯著波動。
我們受制於與資料隱私權、資料保護及其他相關事項有關的法律與法規，這些法律與法規可能有所變更，而我們若未能遵守，可能對我們的業務與聲譽造成負面影響。
我們曾參與股東訴訟，未來亦可能參與更多股東訴訟，這可能會對我們的業務、財務狀況與營運成果造成損害。
失去我們關鍵管理階層及其他員工可能影響我們的業務。
paragraphs: 下列為投資本公司證券所涉及之重要風險摘要，投資人應謹慎考量。本公司業務、財務狀況、營運成果與現金流可能受多項因素影響，無論是否已知或未知，包括但不限於下文所述因素，任何一項或數項因素可能直接或間接導致本公司實際營運成果與財務狀況與過去或預期未來之營運成果與財務狀況有重大差異。上述任何因素，全部或部分，可能對本公司業務、財務狀況、營運成果、現金流及普通股價格造成重大且不利的影響。此外，尚有其他未為本公司所知或目前認為不重要之風險與不確定性，亦可能影響本公司業務營運。
上述風險因素對理解本年度報告表10-K或其它地方之任何陳述可能為重要。以下資訊應與本公司財務報表及其相關附註，位於第二部分，項目8，"財務報表與補充資料"，以及第二部分，項目7，"管理層對財務狀況與營運成果之討論與分析"一同閱讀。
由於下列因素，以及其它影響本公司財務狀況與營運成果之因素，過去財務表現不應視為未來表現之可靠指標，投資人亦不應以歷史趨勢預測未來期間之結果或趨勢。請同時參閱本報告中項目1前之"關於未來展望之陳述"部分。
本公司面臨通貨膨脹壓力，影響我們的成本與所銷售產品之需求。近年來，本公司業務受全球供應鏈限制及在營運國家與市場之經濟或政治條件不利變動影響，導致通貨膨脹成本壓力升高。此等通貨膨脹壓力亦可能因地緣政治動盪與經濟政策行動而進一步加劇，並可能導致經濟衰退環境。此外，利率不利變動可能導致我們之借款成本隨時間增加。

通貨膨脹壓力也可能對我們所銷售產品之需求產生負面影響。消費者因應通貨膨脹壓力而減少或延後非必要開支，特別是消費性電子產品，已導致並可能繼續導致我們產品之需求減少，進而導致銷售額減少。我們若無法適當地提高價格以抵銷與通貨膨脹壓力相關之成本增加，或以其他方式緩衝其影響，將增加我們之營運成本，並可能進一步降低我們之毛利率與獲利能力。若此等影響持續或顯著，將可能導致未來需進行減值測試，或對我們之營運成果造成重大負面影響。
